title: Pass 3 finite-element dorsal-mesentery membrane + discrete gut rod coupling: mesh, Pitx2 gradient and observation-derived comparison targets for 2011-savin-gut-looping-differential-growth.py
provenance_note: Every entry under `mesh_defaults` is a MODELLING ASSUMPTION of the Pass 3 reduced model, not a measurement from Savin et al. (2011). Entries under `comparison_targets` are arithmetic re-expressions of the SHA-256-pinned observations in gut_looping_differential_growth_reference.json (L_t / N_loops_obs and the analytical c_lambda, c_R predictions). Nothing here is fitted to simulation output.

sources.used_for: L_t, L_m, R_t, R_i, h_m, E_t, E_m, lambda_obs, R_obs, N_loops_obs per stage (pinned reference JSON)
Qualitative basis for a Pitx2-dependent stiffness heterogeneity of the dorsal mesentery (condensed mesenchyme, columnar epithelium); gradient amplitude is NOT reported there
Left-right asymmetric dorsal-mesentery architecture / leftward tilt; motivates the residual (handedness is not selected by the bending-free membrane used here)

mesh_defaults.element_type: 3-node constant-strain triangle (CST), St.Venant-Kirchhoff plane-stress membrane embedded in 3D
mesh_defaults.width_note: W_m = 0.18 L_m (E12: 2.97 mm). Assumed; Savin et al. (2011) do not tabulate the root-to-gut mesentery width. Sensitivity: N_loops changes < 10 % for W_m/L_m in [0.12, 0.27] at E12 (Pass 3 prototype sweep).
mesh_defaults.root_fraction_note: Dorsal root rest length = 0.7 L_m (trapezoidal fan). Assumed.
mesh_defaults.pitx2_gradient_formula: E_m(eta) = E_m_mean [1 + a (2 eta - 1)], eta = 0 dorsal root, eta = 1 gut edge; E_m(eta) + E_m(1 - eta) = 2 E_m_mean
mesh_defaults.pitx2_gradient_note: a = 0.4 is an assumed amplitude (stiffer toward the gut edge). Swept over {0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8}; a = 0 is the uniform-sheet ablation.
mesh_defaults.boundary_conditions: root nodes fixed; duodenal and ileocecal rod ends pinned; rod ends released when E_m = 0 (surgical ablation)

comparison_targets.note: contour_per_loop_obs_mm = L_t_mm / n_loops_obs from the pinned reference JSON; lambda_pred_mm = 4.55 ell_*, R_pred_mm = 1.68 ell_*
